[Intro]
[E5]

[Verse 1]
[E5]Late at night, all systems go, you've
come to see the show. We
do our best, you're the rest, you
make it real you know.
There's a feeling deep inside that
drives you fuckin' mad. A
feeling of a hammerhead, you
need it oh so bad.

[Chorus]
[C5][B5][A5]A-
[F#5]drenaline starts to flow.
[C5][B5][A5]You're
[F#5]thrashing all around.
[C5]  [B5]  [A5]
[F#5]Acting like a maniac.
Whiplash!

[Pre-Verse]
[E5]

[Verse 2]
Bang your head against the stage, like you
never did before.
Make it ring, make it bleed,
make it really sore.
In a frenzied madness with your
leather and your spikes.
Heads are bobbin' all around, it's
hot as hell tonight.

[Chorus]
[C5][B5][A5]A-

[C5][B5][A5]You're
[F#5]thrashing all around.
[C5]  [B5]  [A5]
[F#5]Acting like a maniac.
Whiplash!
[E5]

[Verse 3]
[E5]Here on stage the Marshall noise is
piercing through your ears. It
kicks your ass, kicks your face, ex-
ploding feeling nears.
Now's the time to let it rip, to
let it fucking loose. We
come in here to maim and kill 'cause
this is what we choose.

[Chorus]
[C5][B5][A5]A-
[F#5]drenaline starts to flow.
[C5][B5][A5]You're
[F#5]thrashing all around.
[C5]  [B5]  [A5]
[F#5]Acting like a maniac.
[D5]  [C#5]  [C5]  [A5]  [G#5]  [G5]

[Bridge]
[E5]
Here we go!

[Solo]
[E5]

[Verse 4]
Show is through, the metal's gone, it's
time to hit the road. A-
nother town, 'nother gig, a-
gain we will explode.
Hotel rooms and motorways, 'cause
life out here is raw. We'll
never stop, we'll never quit, 'cause
we're Metallica.
